prompts.add: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished square HUD button artwork for Ayothaya Folk Mystic, a Thai fantasy MMORPG. Friendly hand-painted fantasy inventory style, dimensional antique gold rim with restrained Thai lotus corner flourishes, polished deep jade-green inset, warm ivory-gold central symbol with bold readable silhouette and subtle cast shadow. Square rounded corners, straight-on UI view, centered in square canvas with 10 percent transparent margin, entire rim visible. Actual transparent background outside the button silhouette. Rich painted materials consistent across a matching game HUD set, legible at 48 px. No words, letters, numbers, watermark, extra icons, environment or external backing tile. Central symbol: one large clear thick PLUS sign +. This is the add shortcut-row button.
